summary: Moonshot AI released open weights for its Kimi K3.1 Pro model, and a new open model turns a single photo into a 3D scene.

picks.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro: open weights for a 2.8-trillion-parameter model
picks.note: Moonshot AI published the weights of Kimi K3.1 Pro, which its model card calls an open-weight, multimodal model built for agent tasks such as coding and financial research. It is a mixture-of-experts design (only part of the model runs for each token) with 2.8T total and 104B active parameters, and a 1-million-token context window. The license is a custom Kimi license, not a standard open-source one.

picks.title: Idol turns one image into a 3D Gaussian splat
picks.note: Idol is an open model that takes one picture of an object and generates a 3D Gaussian splat (a 3D scene made of many small colored blobs), including sides the picture never showed. The model card says it uses 7.2 GB of GPU memory, runs on consumer GPUs and writes a standard .ply file. It needs access to two gated encoder models and an NVIDIA GPU. The license is Apache 2.0.
